paper: Xiao et al., Short Interest Trend Prediction with Large Language Models, ICIAI 2024, doi:10.1145/3655497.3655500
label_definition: sign(S[t+1]-S[t-1]); S = FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume (TRFs + ADF); paper-faithful, NOT short interest
filters: ASCII-only titles, 1-50 FLAN-T5 tokens, exact (title, ticker, date) duplicates removed
demo_selection: random from training split, fixed per test title (seed = SEED*1000003 + index)
prompt_template:
Read the news title below and determine how the short interest of {company} changes.

{title}

OPTIONS:
1. increase
2. decrease

ANSWER:
demo_format: full template + ' <gold label>', demos joined by blank lines
decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=5, first of increase/decrease/1./2. in output; otherwise invalid (counted wrong)
metrics: per-class F1, support-weighted F1, macro F1 (sklearn, labels=[increase, decrease])
